description: This Open Energy Transition toolset extracts and compares electricity-infrastructure records from Wikidata and OpenStreetMap. Its scripts fetch Wikidata classes and subclasses by country, compare power plants by name and geographic proximity, and write country-level CSV outputs. The purpose is to identify missing or conflicting plant and substation records before they enter a power-system inventory. Spatial coverage depends on the chosen countries and available source records; the scripts do not provide a fixed historical time series. Code and documented example outputs are available from GitHub under CC0-1.0 terms at no charge. A limitation is that entity matching by location and name can produce false links, and both community databases may omit facilities. The repository publishes some generated CSV files, but this record describes the preparation tool, not a verified national plant dataset. It can support generation-asset inventory building for electricity capacity and hazard simulations. The catalogue's data-open-infrastructure-map is a related OSM view; no comparison run or API query was made here.
name: OSM Wikidata electricity infrastructure toolset
notes: G7 G7-1264. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
